Compute Leaf-Wetness Modifier for Infection Rate

Source: R/seir.R
dot-compute_wetness_modifier.Rd

Supports two modes:

  • Simple wetness (simple_wetness = TRUE): binary 0/1 using daily thresholds RHUM >= rhlim OR RAIN >= rainlim.

  • Hourly wetness (simple_wetness = FALSE): computes wet hours via .calculate_leaf_wetness() and maps to [0, 1] either linearly (wet/24) or through interpolation over user-supplied RcW.

Usage

.compute_wetness_modifier(
  w,
  simple_wetness,
  rhlim,
  rainlim,
  weighted_wetness,
  RcW
)

Arguments

w

Weather data for the simulation window.

simple_wetness

Logical; if TRUE use binary daily wetness.

rhlim

Numeric RH threshold (%).

rainlim

Numeric rainfall threshold (mm).

weighted_wetness

Logical; passed to .calculate_leaf_wetness().

RcW

NULL or 2-column numeric matrix giving wetness-response curve.

Value

Numeric vector of daily wetness multipliers (typically bounded [0, 1]).

Details

Internal helper that computes daily wetness effects applied to Rc in seir().

See also

seir(), .calculate_leaf_wetness(), .interp()
